newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria Finmin says not received Creditanstalt bid.
newsitem.headline: Austria Finmin says not received Creditanstalt bid.

text.p: Austrian Finance Minister Viktor Klima on Friday said he had not yet received an offer for government sell-off candidate Creditanstalt-Bankverein by the Austro-Italian-German consortium.
Asked whether he had received an offer by the consortium, Klima said "not yet." The deadline for the bid expires today.
"It is now midday Friday but not midnight Friday," Klima told journalists at a news conference in reference to the deadline.
Klima reiterated the offer had to contain specific details about the offering price, the composition of the consortium, and a clearly specified timeframe for the deal.
"We have to deal with this very carefully, not least from a legal perspective," he said.
Klima said there must be no dramatic changes in the compostion of the consortium. "That would be unfair to all the other interested parties which have been in touch with us in the meantime."

Earlier, Die Erste savings bank, a member of the consortium which also includes EA-Generali, Commerzbank of Germany and Banca Commerciale Italiana, said it expects to be able to make "an attractive" offer for Creditanstalt within the deadline set. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12254
